title: Modular String Hashing Transformation
description: You are given a string s of length n and an integer k. The length n is a multiple of k. Divide s into n/k contiguous blocks of length k. For each block, calculate the sum of the positions of its characters in the English alphabet (a=0, b=1, ..., z=25). Map this sum modulo 26 back to a character and concatenate these characters to form a new string of length n/k.
input_format:
The first line contains the string s.
The second line contains the integer k.
output_format: Print the transformed string of length n/k.
constraints:
1 <= k <= 100
k <= s.length <= 1000
s.length is divisible by k
s contains only lowercase English letters
